diseases.name: Dengue
diseases.summary: A mosquito-borne viral infection causing high fever, rash, and joint pain.
diseases.treatment: No specific antiviral treatment — focuses on fluids, rest, and fever management. Seek medical care if bleeding or severe abdominal pain occurs.

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.summary: Spread by infected mosquitoes, causing fever, chills, and fatigue.
prevention: Take prophylaxis if travelling to high-risk areas
diseases.treatment: Antimalarial medication prescribed based on parasite species — early diagnosis via blood test is critical.

diseases.name: Seasonal Influenza
diseases.summary: A contagious respiratory illness common during seasonal transitions.
prevention: Avoid close contact with sick individuals
diseases.treatment: Rest, fluids, and over-the-counter fever relief. Antivirals may help if started within 48 hours for high-risk patients.

diseases.name: Cholera
diseases.summary: A waterborne bacterial infection causing severe diarrhea and dehydration.
diseases.treatment: Oral rehydration salts are the priority; severe cases require IV fluids and antibiotics.

diseases.name: Tuberculosis
diseases.summary: A bacterial infection primarily affecting the lungs, treatable with early detection.
prevention: Complete full treatment course if diagnosed
diseases.treatment: A 6+ month course of combination antibiotics under the national TB program — completing the full course is essential.

diseases.name: Heat-related Illness
diseases.summary: Heat exhaustion and heatstroke risk rising with summer temperatures.
prevention: Take breaks in shade or cool areas
diseases.treatment: Move to a cool area, hydrate, and cool the body with damp cloths. Seek emergency care for confusion or loss of consciousness.
